aistatuspage.henuz-olculecek-bir-is-yapi: Nothing to measure yet. Once the first call is processed, speed, duration and token counts appear here.
aistatuspage.otomatik-cozumleme-kapali-g: Automatic analysis is off. Calls are transcribed, but no summary or ledger is produced. Turn it on under Settings → Analysis.
aistatuspage.sira-gercekten-denenecek-si: The order is the order actually tried. When the one above does not answer, the next one is used.
askpage.bulunan-alintilar-soruyu-tam-kar: The excerpts found do not fully answer the question. Try different words, or loosen the filters.
askpage.kayitlar-taraniyor-ve-okunuyor-y: Reading through the recordings. On a local model this can take a minute.
askpage.konusulanlara-dair-bir-soru-sor-: Ask a question about what was said. The answer is built only from your own recordings, with the excerpts it rests on underneath — you are not asked to believe it unread.
askpage.ornek-ahmet-le-fiyat-konusunda-n: For example: what was said about the price with Ahmet?

callwindow.bu-oneri-bir-daha-gosterilmez: If you dismiss it, it will not be suggested again.
callwindow.buraya-yazdiklarin-sana-aitti: What you write here is yours. It survives even if the call is analysed again.
callwindow.celiski-cevapsiz-soru-ve-zama: Looks for contradictions, unanswered questions and timing mismatches. Every finding comes with a verbatim quote; the judgement is yours.
callwindow.dayandigi-ani-dinle: Listen to the moment it rests on
callwindow.listeden-sec-ya-da-yaz-ve-ent: Pick from the list or type and press Enter — e.g. important, threatened
callwindow.metin-hazir-cozumleme-sozleri: The text is ready. Analysis extracts promises, changing figures and flags — the audio is not processed again, only the text is read.
callwindow.modelin-gorusudur-metinden-ci: The model's opinion — an inference from text, not an arbiter of truth. You decide.
callwindow.oneridir-sen-onaylamadan-hicb: A suggestion — nothing is written anywhere until you approve it.
callwindow.oznel-yorumdur-bulgu-degildir: A subjective reading, not a finding — for evidence, see the ledger and findings above.
callwindow.sebep-bulgudan-hazir-gelir-gu: The reason is filled in from the finding; you pick the day.
callwindow.sebep-ve-tarihle-bir-hatirlat: Sets a reminder with a reason and a date; it appears on the home screen when the day comes.
callwindow.soz-verilmemis-rakam-ya-da-ta: That is normal for a conversation with no promises, figures or dates.
callwindow.tikla-tutarlilik-sekmesine-gi: Click — goes to the Consistency tab.
callwindow.tikla-ya-da-surukle-o-andan-d: Click or drag — you listen from that moment.
callwindow.tum-gorusme-sen-karsi-taraf-a: Switches between the whole call, you, and the other party.

contactspage.bu-gorusme-icin-acik-oneri-: No open suggestions for this call — they appear here after analysis; open the call to set up and act on them.

contactspage.oneridir-sen-onaylamadan-hi: A suggestion — nothing is written anywhere until you approve it.
contactspage.sesi-bastan-yaziya-dok: Transcribes the audio again from scratch. The audio is already on disk; contact, tags and notes are kept.

contactwindow.bu-bilgileri-sen-girersin-: You enter these details. The application never writes anything about people on its own; what comes out of conversations stays in the Ledger, with quotes.
contactwindow.bu-gorusmede-notun-var: You have a note on this call
contactwindow.bu-kisi-hakkinda-kendi-not: Your own note about this person. Separate from call notes, and never deleted by reprocessing.

contactwindow.bu-tarihe-en-yakin-gorusme: Scrolls to the call nearest this date (does not filter)
contactwindow.bulunan-satira-cift-tiklay: Double-click a result to open that call and listen from that moment.
contactwindow.dosya-arsive-kopyalanir-ve: The file is copied into the archive and shrunk; private data such as location (EXIF) is dropped.
contactwindow.henuz-bilgi-yok-etiket-ve-: No details yet. Type a label and a value and add them — for example 'Profession: Architect'.
healthpage.bir-kaydedici-basariya-benzey: A recorder fails in ways that look like success: the wrong device records silence, a graphics card is visible but unusable, a service runs out of credit, a disk fills up. Every one of those is asked here out loud.
healthpage.bir-sey-ters-gittiginde-son-u: When something goes wrong you can copy the last three days of log and send it. It contains no conversation text, no contact names and no API keys — only what was done when, and what failed.
healthpage.bu-makinenin-ne-kadar-hizli-o: How fast this machine is cannot be read off its specification: the same card behaves differently with an old driver or when another application is holding memory. The measurement transcribes real audio and times it.
healthpage.bu-sayfanin-ekran-goruntusu-y: A screenshot of this page contains everything anybody would ask for.
healthpage.butun-gorusmeler-duz-markdown: Every call as plain markdown, one page per person. Readable without this application.
healthpage.gunluk-ayrintisi-aciklama: Normal: what happened to your calls. Verbose: what the application decided and why. Debug: what did NOT happen and the number that stopped it — choose this while chasing a fault. No transcript text, contact name or API key is written at any level.
healthpage.gunluk-debug-secildi: The log now also records what did not happen and the number that stopped it.
healthpage.gunluk-dosyalarini-siler-bir-: Deletes the log files. Clearing before retrying an error keeps the log you send down to one subject.
healthpage.gunluk-normal-secildi: The log now records only what happened to your calls.
healthpage.gunluk-verbose-secildi: The log now records what the application decided and why.
healthpage.hazirlanir-ve-uygulama-yenide: Replaces the WHOLE archive with this backup, settings included. Staged, and put in place when the application restarts. Your current data is not deleted but set aside — restoring the wrong file must not destroy the archive you were trying to protect.
healthpage.baska-bir-yedekteki-gorusmele: Adds the calls from another backup to the ones here. What you already have is kept, nothing is deleted, and no restart is needed.
healthpage.kisa-bir-ornek-yaziya-dokulur: A short sample is transcribed and the real-time factor measured. If the model is not downloaded yet, this step fetches it.
healthpage.veritabani-ve-ayarlar-tek-dos: The database and settings in one file. Recordings dominate the size, so they are left out by default — the transcripts, the ledger and the settings are still backed up in full.
healthpage.yalnizca-bakar-hicbir-surum-s: Only looks. No version is installed until you approve it.
labelcallwindow.bu-pencere-basligini-bu-: Remember this window title for this person
ledgerpage.gorusmeyi-bu-andan-ac: Open the call at this moment
ledgerpage.tutulmamis-sozler-degisen-rak: Unkept promises, changed figures and unanswered questions — everybody in one place. Under every line are the words themselves; click the time, listen, decide for yourself.
ledgerpage.bos-ve-tekrarlanan-kayitlari-: Removes ledger entries that say nothing and exact duplicates. Your own rulings are untouched.
mergecontactwindow.hangi-kisi-buraya-kat: Which person should be merged into this one?
movecallwindow.bu-pencere-basligini-eski: Unbind this window title from the old person
movecallwindow.kisi-adi-yaz-ya-da-asagid: Type a name or pick from below
movecallwindow.yoksa-bu-baslikla-gelen-s: Otherwise later calls with this title will still go to the old person.
overviewpage.alti-haftaya-yayilmis-uc-or: Three sample calls spread over six weeks: a price changes twice, a promise goes past its date, the same question is dodged twice. The ledger, the transcript and the share of talking all work exactly as they do on real data. One click removes them whenever you like.
overviewpage.bugun-icin-hatirlatma-yok-b: No reminders for today. Right-click a call or a card and choose 'Remind me'.
overviewpage.bunlar-gercek-kayit-degil-k: These are not real recordings. Remove them whenever you like so they do not mix with your own calls.
overviewpage.buraya-surukle-asagidaki-go: Drag here: drop the calls from the list on the left you want to keep track of, or right-click and choose 'Add to important'.
overviewpage.gorusmelerden-cikarilan-one: Suggestions extracted from calls; nothing is written anywhere until you approve it.
overviewpage.gorusmeyi-ac-yukaridaki-pan: Open call · can be dragged to the Important panel on the right
overviewpage.islenirken-silinemez: A call being processed cannot be deleted; stop it first under Durum › İşlemler
overviewpage.metin-yoksa-veya-isleniyors: Disabled when there is no text or the call is being processed
overviewpage.ne-kaydedildi-ne-bekliyor-n: What was recorded, what is waiting, and what needs you.
overviewpage.ses-dosyasi-silinmis: No audio file — retention expired or it was deleted
overviewpage.ses-yoksa-veya-isleniyorsa: Disabled when there is no audio file or the call is being processed
overviewpage.soylenmis-ve-tarihi-gecmis-: Said, and past its date. The quote is the promise itself — the judgement is yours.
overviewpage.sozun-verildigi-ani-dinle: Open the call · plays the moment the promise was made
overviewpage.sozun-verildigi-gorusmeyi-a: Opens the call where the promise was made
overviewpage.whatsapp-ya-da-telegram-uze: Recording starts by itself when you make a voice call on WhatsApp or Telegram. Before your first call it is worth testing audio capture under Status — a silent recording looks exactly like a successful one.
processingpage.bu-sekmede-gorunen-butun-: Requeues every call shown on this tab.
processingpage.bu-sekmede-gorunen-gorusm: Rebuilds the ledger of the calls shown on this tab from their text. The audio is not processed again.
processingpage.cozumleme-sekmesinde-bekl: Shows what is waiting on the Analysis tab
processingpage.cozumleme-sekmesinde-bite: Shows what is finished on the Analysis tab
processingpage.defteri-mevcut-metinden-y: Rebuilds the ledger from the existing text; the audio is not processed again.
processingpage.islenemeyen-gorusmeleri-g: Shows the calls that could not be processed
processingpage.sesi-sececegin-bir-motorl: Transcribes the audio again with an engine you choose.
processingpage.yaziya-dokme-sekmesinde-b: Shows what is waiting on the Transcription tab
recordingoverlay.bu-gorusme-boyunca-seri: Hide the strip for this call — recording continues
remindwindow.ana-ekrandaki-kartin-baslig: Becomes the title of the card on the home screen — on the day it arrives, it says why.
remindwindow.bu-gorusmeyle-ilgili-aklind: What you want to keep in mind about this call…
remindwindow.gorusmenin-notudur-notlar-s: This is the call's note — it also shows on the Notes tab; when the reminder day comes, the context is here.
remindwindow.or-cuma-gunu-evrak-sozunu-s: E.g. Ask about the Friday paperwork promise
renamecontactwindow.gorusmeler-sozler-ve: Calls, promises and ledger entries stay as they are; only the name changes.
reprocesswindow.ses-diskte-duruyor-yalni: The audio stays on disk; only this stage is produced again. Your contact, tags and notes are kept.
searchpage.aramayi-ve-sonuclari-temizler: Clears the search and its results.
searchpage.bu-etiketi-tasiyan-gorusmeler: Lists calls with this tag; a second click removes it
searchpage.butun-gorusmelerin-metni-aran: Searches the text of every call. Turkish casing rules apply, so typing ışık also finds IŞIK. The start of a word is enough: searching kitap also finds kitabı.
searchpage.gorusmeyi-bu-andan-ac: Open the call at this moment
searchpage.kimin-ne-soyledigi-tahmin-deg: Who said what is not a guess: the two streams are recorded separately, so it is known.
searchpage.yalnizca-bu-kisiyle-olan-goru: Search only calls with this person
settingswindow.acikken-3-mart-ta-15-bin-: When on, cross-call contradictions like 'on 3 March they said 15 thousand' are caught. With a cloud provider, past quotes leave the machine too.
settingswindow.acikken-model-denetimle-b: When on, the model states its opinion alongside the check: a suspicion level (none/low/medium/high) and a tactic-by-tactic rationale. This is a model's opinion — an inference from text, not an arbiter of truth; a claim whose quote cannot be found in the transcript is still discarded. It is an additional paid request.
settingswindow.anahtari-yapistir-kendili: Paste the key — it is tested on its own
settingswindow.arayuzun-dili-konusulan-d: Only the language of the text on screen. The language spoken on your calls is unaffected — that is set under Transcription.
settingswindow.asagidaki-hata-oranlari-t: The error rates below are real measurements for Turkish. Lower is better; an empty cell means no measurement exists for that dataset.
settingswindow.baglantiyi-sinadiginda-li: Testing the connection fills this list with the models the provider actually serves. This is an extraction task, so it does not need a huge model; what matters is its Turkish.
settingswindow.bes-saniye-kayit-alip-iki: Records five seconds and tells you whether sound really arrived on both streams. Talk during the test and play some music at the same time.
settingswindow.bluetooth-kulakliklar-win: Bluetooth headsets appear to Windows twice: the hands-free version carries the microphone, drops to 16 kHz and takes the headphones out of stereo. The quality loss is obvious. Where you can, choose the computer's own microphone for input and the headset's stereo output for listening.
settingswindow.bu-modda-gorusme-kaydi-se: In this mode the recording is uploaded to the service you choose. Audio carries who was speaking, their tone, and the background.
settingswindow.bu-saglayici-bulutta-cali: This provider runs in the cloud: the text of the call is sent out. The audio is not.
settingswindow.bu-servise-yukleme-yapila: This service cannot be uploaded to
settingswindow.bulut-servisidir-ozetler-: A cloud service: summaries are sent to Notion's servers.
settingswindow.bulut-uzerinden-yaziya-do: Transcribing in the cloud needs at least one service. Start with Add a service above; define two and the second takes over when the first does not answer.
settingswindow.cozumleme-bitince-tutarli: Also check consistency when analysis finishes
settingswindow.cozumleme-servisi-secilme: Calls are transcribed but no summary or ledger is produced. Pick a service above: llama-server, Ollama or LM Studio on this machine; OpenRouter, OpenAI or Anthropic in the cloud.
settingswindow.cozumlemeyle-birlikte-atm: Alongside analysis, suggests the steps you should take. Only a suggestion — nothing is written anywhere until you approve it.
settingswindow.defter-ucuz-bir-modelde-k: The ledger can stay on a cheap model while this reading goes to a stronger one (e.g. anthropic/claude-fable-5). The model is called through the selected provider.
settingswindow.dosyalari-hazir-ilk-gorus: Its files are here — the first call will not wait.
settingswindow.genel-aciklama: The interface itself — language, theme and starting with Windows.
settingswindow.gorusme-basladiginda-hang: Which applications are recorded when a call starts, and how the audio is captured.
settingswindow.gorusme-bitince-otomatik-: Analyse automatically when a call ends
settingswindow.gorusme-bittikten-sonra-e: How long to wait after a call before using the graphics card. On a laptop the card shares its power budget with video calling, so this wait is what keeps the recorder from being noticed.
settingswindow.gorusme-ozetlerinin-uygul: Writing call summaries outside the application.
settingswindow.gorusme-penceresinde-iste: A free-form commentary section in the call window, produced on request. It is a subjective reading and labelled as such; when off, the section is not shown at all.
settingswindow.gorusmelerde-hangi-dilin-: The language spoken on calls. Told to the recogniser in advance; getting it right improves accuracy noticeably. Independent of the interface language. Not used while mixed language below is on.
settingswindow.grup-aramasinda-herkes-te: In a group call everyone at the far end arrives mixed into one stream, so who said what stops being a fact and becomes a guess. Off, the audio is kept and the transcript and analysis are skipped. Turn it on knowing the speaker labels will be wrong.
settingswindow.henuz-indirilmedi-gb-ilk-: Not downloaded yet ({0} GB). It will download on the first call and hold that call up.
settingswindow.her-sey-buluta-gonderiliy: "Always upload" is selected above. The local model settings below are not used in this mode — downloading a model would achieve nothing.
settingswindow.hoparlorle-konusurken-kar: On speakers the other party's voice also reaches the microphone and who said what becomes uncertain. Headphones still give the best result.
settingswindow.istek-bicimi-openai-ninki: Its request format differs from OpenAI's. It can be kept and its balance watched, but it is not used for transcription.
settingswindow.kapaliyken-aramalar-izlen: When off, calls are still watched but not recorded by themselves — you record by hand with "Start recording" whenever you want. It also toggles in one click from the notification area.
settingswindow.kapaliyken-gorusme-pencer: When off, it runs by hand from the button in the call window. Every run is a paid request.
settingswindow.kapaliyken-iki-tarafin-if: When off, both sides' statements are observed — that is the default: the tool observes the conversation, not the person.
settingswindow.kapaliyken-kayit-ve-yaziy: When off, recording and transcription still work; only the ledger is not produced.
settingswindow.kapaliyken-yapilandirma-k: When off the configuration is kept but this service is not tried.
settingswindow.karisik-dil: Detect the language from the call
settingswindow.karisik-dil-aciklama: Off, every recording is taken to be Turkish. If the other person speaks another language — Russian, English, any of them — what they said comes back as Turkish syllables and means nothing. On, the language is read from the recording; calls that switch to English mid-sentence come out right too. Slower; large models only.
settingswindow.karsi-tarafi-duydugun-cih: The device you HEAR the other party on. If you listen with AirPods then AirPods must be selected here — the wrong device means the other party is never recorded, and nothing reports an error.
settingswindow.karsi-tarafi-sesinden-tan: Recognises the other party by voice: shows who they are and your notes while the call runs, and files the call under them when it ends. A voiceprint is kept for each person — not the audio, 256 numbers; it cannot be turned back into sound and it is encrypted in backups. Recognition happens once, after the other party has spoken for at least 30 seconds.
settingswindow.karsi-tarafin-sesi-nerede: Where the other party's voice is taken from
settingswindow.kayit-surerken-ekranin-us: While recording, a thin strip appears at the top of the screen showing the elapsed time, and it can be stopped from there. Leaving it on is recommended: with only a tray icon, a running recorder and a switched-off one look identical.
settingswindow.kisiyi-pencere-basliginda: When off, you are asked after every call; a name recognised from the title is only prefilled as a suggestion. Generic titles like "Voice call" are never used.
Assign the contact from the window title automatically
settingswindow.konusmanin-metne-cevrilme: Turning speech into text. It can run on this machine or be sent to a service.
settingswindow.konustugun-mikrofon-kulak: The microphone you speak into. If you listen on a headset but talk into the computer's microphone, choose the computer's microphone here.
settingswindow.kulakligi-yeni-taktiysan-: Refresh the list if you have just plugged in a headset
settingswindow.metinden-taahhutleri-degi: The layer that pulls promises, changed figures and unanswered questions out of the text. The model only finds and quotes; the comparisons are done by the application.
settingswindow.model-ilk-kullanimda-kend: The model downloads by itself on first use, but that keeps a call waiting. Fetch and test it here beforehand.
settingswindow.okumada-sana-bu-adla-sesl: The reading addresses you by this name and refers to the other party by the name you filed them under. Left empty it says "sen".
settingswindow.ollama-llama-server-ve-lm: Ollama, llama-server and LM Studio are probed on their usual ports.
settingswindow.onceki-gorusmelerin-defte: Send ledger quotes from earlier calls as context
settingswindow.otomatik-ekran-karti-eris: Automatic uses the graphics card when it can be reached.
settingswindow.saglayicidaki-modelleri-l: Lists the provider's models; you can search and pick one.
settingswindow.senin-sesin-nereden-alins: Where your own voice is taken from
settingswindow.ses-opus-a-sikistirilip-g: Audio is compressed to Opus and, where needed, split at silent moments, so no word is cut in half. Each part is tried separately, a rate limit is waited out and retried, and finished parts are cached so a retry does not start from the beginning.
settingswindow.sesi-sikistir-aciklama: Turns a processed recording into Opus: the same audio, a fifth of the size. The two sides stay apart, and it is decoded again for playback, clips and re-transcription. The quality is kept deliberately high because re-transcription reads this file. Older recordings are compressed in the background at startup.
settingswindow.sifir-suresiz-saklamak-de: Zero keeps them forever. Only the audio goes — transcripts, the ledger and notes stay. Calls on the board or with a note are never swept.
settingswindow.signal-desktop-aramalari: Signal Desktop calls. Has no effect unless Signal Desktop is installed.
settingswindow.sirayla-denenir-biri-ceva: Tried in order. If one does not answer or runs out of credit, the next takes over — there is only one copy of a recording and it must not be lost.
settingswindow.sistemi-izle-windows-un-a: Follow system changes with Windows' light/dark setting. The choice is applied when saved.
settingswindow.sozluk-aciklama: Words transcription keeps getting wrong: product names, people, jargon. One per line or comma-separated. Passed to the local engine and to the cloud services alike.
settingswindow.su-an-kullanilmiyor-yalni: Not in use — "Where should it run" is set to this machine only. Adding a service switches to Automatic.
settingswindow.telegram-desktop-aramalar: Telegram Desktop calls. The contact's name is taken automatically from the call window's title.
settingswindow.toplam-sutunu-model-agirl: The total column is the model weights plus the context memory. On a 6 GB card Windows itself uses 0.5–1.2 GB, so in practice anything up to 4.65 GB runs comfortably.
settingswindow.tutarlilik-aciklama: Reads the conversation for contradictions, evasion and timeline mismatches. Not a lie detector: every finding carries a verbatim quote and timestamp, and the judgement is yours.
settingswindow.tutarlilik-icin-once-cozu: The consistency check uses the analysis service. Until a provider is chosen in the Analysis section, nothing here has any effect.
settingswindow.vault-klasorune-markdown-: Writes markdown files into the vault folder. Entirely local; nothing leaves the machine.
settingswindow.veriler-aciklama: Where the archive lives and how long audio is kept. Recordings, transcripts and the database all sit in this folder — it is the one place to back up.
settingswindow.whatsapp-desktop-uzerinde: Records voice calls made through WhatsApp Desktop.
settingswindow.windows-acilisinda-baslat: Starts quietly in the system tray when the computer boots; no window opens. While off, nothing is recorded unless you open the app yourself.
settingswindow.yalnizca-whatsapp-ve-tele: Takes only WhatsApp and Telegram audio, so music playing in the background stays out of the recording. In exchange, this Windows interface reports no clock information and is known to produce silent recordings in some applications. With it off, all system audio is recorded, and that is more reliable.
settingswindow.yerelde-calistirmak-varsa: Running locally is the default and nothing leaves the machine. Sending to the cloud means sending the call's audio out — not just its text.
setupwindow.bu-adim-tamamlanamadi: This step could not be completed
setupwindow.hicbirini-kurmadan-da-kullan: You can use it without installing any of this
setupwindow.voicetranscript-whatsapp-ve-: SocialZeka records WhatsApp and Telegram calls and transcribes them into Turkish. It installs what it needs itself — you only have to wait.
setupwindow.yaziya-dokmeyi-bir-api-uzeri: If you transcribe through an API you need neither Python nor a model; an API key is enough. In exchange, the call's audio is uploaded to that service. Under Settings you can define several providers and put them in order: if one does not answer, the next takes over.
tagmanagerwindow.bu-liste-etiketlerin-go: This list is how tags look: name, icon, colour. Deleting a definition does not remove the tag from calls — it only takes away its outfit.
todopage.aciklama: What you wrote down, the steps analysis suggested, and the reminders you set on calls — in one list. Ticking closes each in its own place.
todopage.bos: Nothing to do. Write one above, or set a reminder on a call.
todopage.oneriyi-reddet: Dismiss — it will not be suggested again
todopage.yeni-ornek: E.g. Send the paperwork on Friday
transcriptversions.aciklama: Kept every time this call is transcribed. Decide which engine heard it better from the figures.

settingswindow.kocluk-aciklama: Your own speaking habits: what is counted, what is not, and why.
settingswindow.aliskanlik-sayimi: Habit counting (swearing, fillers, pace, what you disclosed)
settingswindow.bu-makinede-model-yok-ucr: On this machine, no model, free. Only your own channel is counted.
settingswindow.sozlukler-okunamadi: The dictionaries could not be read.
settingswindow.niyet-karti-aciklama: Asks, as a recording starts, what you have decided not to say. What you write is your own note; whether you kept to it is not measured.
settingswindow.kelime-guveni-esigi-henuz: Word confidence threshold: not measured yet — it will be set per engine by listening.
settingswindow.gecmis-gorusmeleri-say-ac: Counts conversations that have a transcript and no current count, in the background at the lowest priority. It does not enter the queue and does not touch recording or transcription.
settingswindow.sayilacak-gorusme-yok: Nothing to count — everything is up to date.
settingswindow.olculmeyenler-liste: Emotion or tone label · lie or trust score · dialect · playing a part — not offered, because none of them can be measured.
settingswindow.olculmeyenler-neden:
Emotion or tone label: speech emotion recognition has not been validated for Turkish, and emotion inferred from text is the reader's guess. The model does not actually hear anything.

Lie or trust score: the base rate gets worse over a run of conversations and the errors accumulate. Not given at the contact level either — a number that is wrong is carried for years.

Dialect: the transcribers pull speech towards written Turkish. What a counter would measure is how much the engine corrected that day, not how you spoke; and what it missed cannot be counted from text at all.

Playing a part: intent cannot be measured. The intent card stands in its place — you decide what you will not say, and the machine only keeps the note.
sozlukwindow.eslesme-kurali: The matching rule: the stem must start a word, and what follows it must be nothing or one of the endings you allow. A stem that merely sits inside a word is not counted. Changes take effect from the next count.
sozlukwindow.kufur-aciklama: Counted only in your own channel.
sozlukwindow.dolgu-aciklama: Phrases that fall between sentences and carry no meaning.
sozlukwindow.haric-aciklama: A word written here is never counted, whichever stem it would otherwise match. This is how you take a wrongly caught word out of the count.
sozlukwindow.sive-olculmuyor: Dialect is not measured; this section is deliberately empty.
sozlukwindow.sive-neden: The transcribers pull speech towards written Turkish. A dialect counter would measure how much the engine corrected that day rather than how you spoke — and there is no way to count what it missed from text either. It opens if a pre-measurement passes.
sozlukwindow.degisiklik-sonraki-sayimda: These lists are yours: after the first seeding no machine writes to them and no re-analysis touches them. Deleting a row changes nothing that was said, only what the next count looks for.
niyetwindow.soylemek-istemedigim: What I do not want to say in this conversation
niyetwindow.ornek: e.g. I will not be the one to name the rent figure
niyetwindow.yalniz-senin-notun: Your note alone. No analysis reads it, it is sent nowhere, and whether you kept to it is not measured — intent cannot be read off a transcript.
recordingoverlay.bu-gorusmede-soylemek-i: Note what you do not want to say in this conversation
mirrorpage.aciklama: What you do while you talk — counted, and heard. No commentary; you listen to the moments.
mirrorpage.kisiye-gore-suz: Count only the conversations with this person
mirrorpage.motora-gore-suz: Count only the transcripts this engine produced — engines do not count alike
mirrorpage.onceki-sayim-yok: nothing counted in the earlier window
mirrorpage.bu-donemde-sayim-yok: no counted conversation in this window
mirrorpage.hiz-kelime-zamani-yok: no transcript carries word timings; the rate cannot be measured
mirrorpage.paydasi-yok: no denominator: nothing to measure in this window
mirrorpage.karsi-taraf-sayilmaz: These figures come from your lines alone. The other party's habits are not counted anywhere.
mirrorpage.neden-sive: The transcribers normalise speech towards written Turkish. What a counter measured would be how much the engine normalised that day, not how the speaker spoke. Until a pre-measurement says otherwise the counter is not written; and what is not measured is not counted.
mirrorpage.neden-rol-baslik: Why playing a part is not measured
mirrorpage.neden-rol: Intent cannot be measured, from audio or from text. What stands in its place is the intent card — the line you write before a call saying what you do not intend to say, and the count of the times you afterwards marked it yourself. The ruling is yours, not the machine's.
mirrorpage.neden-duygu: Reading emotion from voice or text is unvalidated in Turkish. A wrong emotion label is worse than none: people read it as a verdict about themselves.
mirrorpage.egri-aciklama: One dot per conversation; the line joins only conversations of the same engine. A dashed line is where the engine changed, a hollow dot a call likely without headphones. Clicking a dot opens that conversation.
mirrorpage.egri-icin-sayim-yok: Nothing to plot for this figure in this window.
mirrorpage.yalniz-dinlenmemisler: Only the ones not listened to
mirrorpage.bu-olcunun-ani-yok: This figure has no separate moments: it comes from the whole conversation.
mirrorpage.n-belirsiz-sayilmadi: {0} moments are uncertain: listed, and not counted.
mirrorpage.ani-dinle: Play the moment where it was said
mirrorpage.bos: No moment for this figure in this window.
callwindow.karsi-taraf-sayilmaz: Only your lines were counted; no habit is counted for the other party.
callwindow.aynam-satir: swearing {0}/min · fillers {1}/100 words · rate {2} wpm · your share {3} · interruptions {4}/10 min · information given {5}
callwindow.aynam-onceki-dokumden: The counts come from an earlier transcript
callwindow.aynam-sayim-yok: Nothing has been counted for this conversation.
callwindow.aynam-sayim-yok-ne-yapmali: If the text is ready, "Count again" counts it now. The dictionary is yours: refresh from here whenever you change it.
recordingoverlay.son-60-saniyede-senin-k: Your share of the speaking time in the last 60 seconds, and an arrow against your own level. A measure, not a warning.
settingswindow.canli-konusma-olceri-acik: On the recording strip, how much of the last 60 seconds was you talking: a percentage, a small bar, and an arrow against your own level (▲ — ▼). It never warns, never changes colour, and never shows a dB figure. Stretches where the other party is audible in your microphone are not counted, because the share would be wrong, and the strip says so. Nothing is stored.
settingswindow.canli-uyari-henuz-olculme: None. An alarm that interrupts you while you are speaking arrives only if a measurement shows you would have wanted it: 10 or more loudness peaks marked in your own archive, with "I would have wanted a warning" on at least 70% of them. That measurement has not been run, so the alarm has not been built.
settingswindow.ses-duzeyi-ve-perde-olcum: On this machine, no model, about ten seconds per call. Numbers and moments are stored; nothing turns them into a mood, tension or honesty — voice-stress lie detection performs at chance. The measurement is kept so the band can be tested at all.
settingswindow.zaman-cizgisinde-ses-seri: The level band on the timeline
settingswindow.ses-seridi-henuz-olculmed: Not drawn yet. Whether the band says anything is settled by listening to 60 peaks and marking whether a change was audible; past 70% it becomes available. The measurement has not been run.
contactcard.gidisat-bos: Nothing has been counted for this person yet.
contactcard.her-sayi-son-donem-onceki-do: Every row: the last 3 months → the 3 before them. The chip changes the line's range, not the numbers. The arrow says which way it moved and carries no colour: which way is better is yours to decide. Months nothing measured are absent from the line.
contactcard.bulgu-yogunlugu-serisi-yok: There is no "findings per month" series: it would measure which checks were run, not the person's behaviour.
contactcard.n-grup-gorusmesi-sayilmadi: {0} group calls were not counted: in a group recording the other side is one mixed channel, so nobody knows who spoke.
contactcard.soz-ozeti: Owed to you, open: {0} ({1} overdue) · owed by you, open: {2} · you marked kept: {3}
contactcard.model-etiketi-aciklama: Rows carrying "model label ≈" are a model's reading: they sit under the Assessment filter and are never added to any rule's count.
contactcard.n-kayit-ses-net-degil: {0} rows rest on unclear audio; they do not feed the bar.
contactcard.reddettiklerin-n-sayilmaz: The ones you turned down ({0}) are not counted.
contactcard.ret-orani-yuzde-30-ustu: More than 30% turned down ({0}/{1}); this kind's bar was removed, the quotes remain.
contactcard.ret-orani-kurali: When more than 30% of a kind is turned down, its bar goes and the quote list stays.
contactcard.dinledim-oyleydi: I listened, that is what was said
contactcard.reddedersen-bir-daha-gelmez: Turned down, this quote will not come back; you can undo it.
contactcard.rakam-yolculugu-aciklama: Only subjects with at least two different values. Every stop plays the moment it was said.
contactcard.elindeki-kayitlar-aciklama: The evidence answer to "give me arguments I can use": this person's own words, by subject, dated and playable. The application does not write arguments for you.
contactcard.modelin-gorusu-kapali: This panel is off by default. Turn it on under Settings › Analysis › "Contact card: the model's opinion"; once on, each reading is a separate paid request.
contactcard.modelin-gorusu-nedir: A subjective reading, not a finding. It stands apart from the evidence above and is never placed on the same ground as it.
contactcard.okuma-imzasi: {0} · {1} · {2} conversations · {3} excerpts · {4} items dropped for want of an anchor
contactcard.katilmiyorum-aciklama: Marks that you disagree with this reading. Marked for three people in a row, the panel switches itself off.
contactcard.katilmadin: You marked that you disagree with this reading. The text stays; this is how it entered the measurement.
contactcard.okuma-yetersiz: There is not enough on record with this person to write a reading: three conversations and twenty excerpts at least. Rather than draw an impression from less, it is left empty.
contactcard.okuma-bayat: There have been conversations since this reading; it rests on the record as it was that day. [Ask again] refreshes it.
contactcard.okuma-model-uygun-olmayabili: Most of the items were dropped because the excerpt they cited was never handed over. This model may not suit the job.
contactcard.okuma-henuz-yok: No reading has been asked for about this person yet. [Ask again] makes one paid request.
contactcard.okuma-servis-yok: No AI service is connected. Choose a provider under Settings → Analysis.
contactcard.okuma-tamamlanamadi: The reading could not be completed: {0}
contactcard.okuma-oznel: This section is the model's subjective reading, not a finding. The counts and quotes above are unaffected by it, and this text enters no figure of theirs.
contactcard.okuma-psikolojik-durum-veril: No psychological or emotional state is given: reading emotion from text or from audio is not validated for Turkish, and getting it wrong does harm.
contactcard.okuma-argumanlar-yazilmiyor: No "arguments you can use" are written. The answer to that is the What you have on record section above: the person's own words, dated and playable.
contactcard.okuma-ayarlardan-kapanir: This panel is turned on and off under Settings › Analysis › "Contact card: the model's opinion"; it is off by default.
settingswindow.ucretli-istek-metin-yanli: When on, a panel appears at the bottom of the contact card: the model writes an impression from your conversations with that person. Each reading is a separate paid request; the text comes out of a machine and can be wrong; it is a reading, not a finding. Off by default.
settingswindow.panelin-iki-siniri: It has two boundaries: no psychological or emotional state is given, and no "arguments you can use" are written.
settingswindow.olcum-olumsuz-aciklama: You disagreed with the reading for three people in a row, so the feature switched itself off. Turning it back on clears this note.
